privacidad_desc: Your privacy and trust are paramount. Learn how we safeguard your personal data in accordance with Peruvian legislation and professional psychological confidentiality.
marco_legal: Statement pursuant to Law No. 29733 (Personal Data Protection Act), Supreme Decree No. 003-2013-JUS, and the Code of Ethics of the College of Psychologists of Peru.
banco_desc: The collected data is held under the personal data bank named 'Patients and Clients', under the responsibility and custody of Lic. Sofia Reynaga Pachas (Consultorio Psicologico America).
finalidad_desc: The provided information (full name, contact details, consultation reason, session history) is exclusively used to: coordinate clinical consultations, issue official tax receipts with SUNAT, maintain confidential clinical files, and provide professional psychological guidance.
consentimiento_desc: By requesting an appointment, enrolling in a workshop, or contacting our channels, you grant your free, prior, express, and informed consent for data processing under this policy.
transferencia_desc: Consultorio Psicologico America guarantees that it does not sell, lease, or transfer your personal data to any third party. All records remain protected under professional secrecy.
arco_titulo: 5. ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition)
arco_desc: As the owner of your personal data, you may exercise your ARCO rights guaranteed by law at any time. You can request to view what data we retain, rectify inaccuracies, or request suppression by contacting our official patient care channel or via the direct request button below.
arco_plazos: Response times are: 20 business days for Access and 10 business days for Rectification, Cancellation, or Opposition pursuant to Peruvian regulations.
seguridad_desc: We implement robust encryption and technical measures. Your preferences and sessions run primarily on your own device (Local-First), minimizing exposure in cloud networks.
